question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket - 11 players in a team**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cricket teams consist of **11 players** each, including a captain and a wicketkeeper.
 
• Cricket is played between two teams with each team taking turns to bat and bowl.
 
• The primary objective of the game is to score more runs than the opposing team.
 
• Cricket is governed by a set of rules known as the **Laws of Cricket**.
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body for cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football** teams consist of 11 players each, not 13 as mentioned.
 
• **Kabaddi** teams consist of 7 players each, not 9 as mentioned.
 
• **Field Hockey** teams consist of 11 players each, not 10 as mentioned.
 
• Understanding the correct number of players is essential for knowing the dynamics and rules of each sport.
